Now, the truth of the matter is, that the only way that we can actually become better at anything is if someone tells us what we are doing wrong. But what happens in our head when we hear that? We think, "what do they know". We think, "I'm the writer". In my case, every time I heard someone suggest I change one line, my head would start arguing that the line was perfect, that they just didn't get it.
